Main menu, saves and settings

The main menu is the original game's menu. Under its buttons the remake adds Etherlords I and Etherlords II: click one to switch games, or Wiki to open this wiki. The game you played last opens at the next start. A game you have not added yet says not installed — add… and opens the game files screen for it.

From the Wiki, open a creature's page to play its attacks, death, and other animations with sound.

What the menu offers

  • Etherlords: New Game (Duel, Campaign, Single Mission), Load Game, Options, Hall of Fame, Credits and Quit. See Duel.
  • Etherlords II: Single (Tutorial, Duel, Campaign, Mission, which also lists custom maps), Multiplayer (network and hot seat duels), Options, Encyclopedia, Credits and Quit. With Etherlords II installed, the remake adds Autochess beside the game choice.

Saves

Saving and loading use the original screens. F5 saves quickly and F9 loads the quick save, on the map and in battle. Saves of the original games cannot be loaded; the engine keeps its own, separately for each game.

Where saves and settings are kept

SystemFolder
Windows%APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Etherlords Duel
Linux~/.local/share/godot/app_userdata/Etherlords Duel
macOS~/Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/Etherlords Duel
Browserthe browser's storage for the site; clearing the site's data removes them
Androidthe app's private storage; uninstalling the app removes them

The folder keeps its earlier name, Etherlords Duel, so older saves continue to work.
